reframes.title: Split each step
reframes.summary: Split each daily time step's 2 million grid cells across 8 GPUs with domain decomposition, exchanging halos every step.

reframes.title: Whole-chain Newton
reframes.summary: Guess all 10,000 states of one MCMC chain at once, then correct every state in parallel with Newton iterations until the chain matches the sequential one.

reframes.title: Scan over days
reframes.summary: Each day's update of the linear reservoir model is an affine map, so compute all 36,500 days at once with a parallel prefix scan instead of the time loop.

reframes.title: Many chains
reframes.summary: Run 4,096 independent MCMC chains side by side on the GPU, one per starting point, and pool their samples.
